messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: metering-service detected token count drift > 18% (eu-west-1). auto-pager -> #incidents. details: delta by emitter group 'ingest-eu-1'.

alex-sre: seeing the spike in the dashboard, looks like counts jumped at 02:12 UTC.

ryan-oncall: on it — grabbing logs and joining call. can someone drop the quick query to show emitter IDs?

paul-billing: query: `SELECT emitter_id, SUM(tokens) as tok, window_start FROM metering.aggregates WHERE window_start >= now() - interval '15 minutes' GROUP BY emitter_id ORDER BY tok DESC LIMIT 10;` — top results show emitter 0x9b3 and 0x2f4 up 10-20x.

alex-sre: logs show repeated retries from proxy for those emitters, lots of 5xx then retries producing duplicate events. suspect at-least-once duplication upstream.

tasha-dataops: checking ingestion offsets and dedupe tables — offset replays present for partition 4 in eu-kafka. consumer lags jumped then rewound.

ryan-oncall: mitigation idea: pause emitter ingestion for the two offending emitter_ids at the proxy layer (rate limit to 0) to stop inflating counts while we triage. Thoughts?

paul-billing: +1 to pause, but note customers already saw overage flags for a subset. We should prevent more flags and start reconciling.

megan-cs: which customers? I need a short list to prepare proactive messages.

paul-billing: looking — temporary overage flags triggered for account ids: acct-952, acct-114, acct-330. magnitude small (10-30 tokens each) but flags are visible in console.

liam-engops: I deployed a temporary routing rule to drop duplicate-ish emitter batches from those emitter_ids at the ingress (added heuristic dedupe). Push shows applied.

alex-sre: confirming stream now looks quieter. duplicate bursts stopped at 02:20 UTC. good.

tasha-dataops: starting a short backfill job to reconcile deduped messages into the ledger and mark duplicates for exclusion. estimate 12m run for 7 partitions.

ryan-oncall: i'll keep pager pinned for 30m. please post any changes to this thread.

paul-billing: action items for billing: 1) suspend automatic overage alerts for the window 02:10-02:28 UTC for eu-west-1, 2) flag impacted accounts for manual review prior to billing, 3) open a customer-facing note draft.

megan-cs: drafting message: "We saw transient duplicate events affecting usage totals for a small set of accounts in EU region between 02:10–02:28 UTC. We're pausing automatic overage notices and will follow up with reconciled usage. No billing will be applied until manual review completes." Will share in #cs-drafts.

alex-sre: root cause initial: kafka consumer group had a rebalance during a maintenance window combined with a proxy retry storm — resulted in duplicate ingestion of the same events. We'll schedule deeper RCA after stabilization.

tasha-dataops: backfill completed at 02:33 UTC. reconciled deltas: emitter 0x9b3 -10,500 tokens (duplicates removed), emitter 0x2f4 -8,900 tokens. ledgers updated.

paul-billing: updated: overage flags cleared for acct-952 and acct-114 after reconciliation; acct-330 had unrelated real usage spike, will remain flagged.

ryan-oncall: rolling back the temporary drop rule now that cleanup is done. leaving a short watch.

liam-engops: posting a runbook note in ops-docs: "pause ingest / dedupe / reconcile flow" and a TL;DR for oncall.

megan-cs: sending customer note to the three impacted accounts (internal review before send).

alex-sre: closing incident alert — monitoring for 1hr. tagging for postmortem: kafka-consumer-rebalance, proxy-retry-backoff, emitter-dedup logic.

paul-billing: follow-ups: (1) implement circuit-breaker at proxy to avoid retry amplification, (2) add a debounce window before overage alerting for sudden short-lived spikes, (3) add more telemetry to detect replayed batches earlier.

megan-cs: will coordinate customer communications and open a support case template.

ryan-oncall: ack. great cross-team response — lowering pager noise. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: metering-service token drift (eu-west-1). duration 00:23:56. incident severity: Sev2. Postmortem assignment: #infra-postmortems.
